system.description:
You cause a creature to either grow much larger, or shrink in size.

Choose a creature within 10 spaces. If it is unwilling, it may make an opposed Resilience check to negate the effect of the spell.

Otherwise, choose one of the below effects.

  • Enlarge

    • The creature's Size increases by +1.

    • The Range of its Melee attacks increases by +1.

    • Its Defense decreases by -1.

    • Its Body increases by +1.

    • Its Training in Stealth decreases by -3.

  • Reduce

    • The creature's Size decreases by -1.

    • Its Body decreases by -1.

    • Its Training in Stealth increases by +3.

These effects last for 1 minute, after which the creature returns to normal.

The creature's gear does not change size with it.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 minutes.
